about.body:
Redactor {version}

Permanent, verifiable PDF redaction.
The original file is never modified.

License: GNU AGPL v3 or later. Uses PyMuPDF (MuPDF), Qt (PySide6), Tesseract language data and Lucide icons.
action.export_tip: Write a new, redacted PDF and verify it
action.include_text_tip: Off by default: project files then contain only positions, not the sensitive text
action.preview_tip: Show marks the way they will look in the exported file
close.info: Save them as a project to continue later. Nothing has been written to the PDF yet.
close.title: Unsaved marks
empty.body: Drop a PDF here, or open one to start marking what must disappear.
empty.promise: The original is never changed. The result is saved as a new file and verified.
error.encrypted: “{name}” is password protected. Remove the password in another program and open it again.
error.title: Redactor
export.always: Always removed: metadata, XMP, attachments, embedded files, JavaScript, links, form values and thumbnails.
export.err_empty: Choose where to save the redacted file.
export.err_same: This is the original file. Redactor never overwrites it, so choose a different name.
export.flatten_hint: Maximum safety: every page becomes a picture and no text remains at all. The file is larger and not searchable.
export.overwrite_warn: A file with this name exists and will be replaced.
export.preview_page: Page {page}, rendered by the same pipeline as the export.
export.remove_hidden: Remove hidden and invisible text (e.g. OCR layers)
export.remove_touched: Also remove vector graphics that only touch a mark
export.title: Export Redacted PDF
hint.no_text: There is no selectable text here. Use the Rectangle tool (R).
hint.scan_needs_ocr: This page is a scan. Run text recognition (O) to select its text, or use the Rectangle tool (R).
hint.scans_found.one: {n} page looks like a scan. Use Tools → Recognize Text to make it searchable.
hint.scans_found.other: {n} pages look like scans. Use Tools → Recognize Text to make them searchable.
marks.empty:
No marks yet.
Select text (T), draw a rectangle (R) or search for data (S).
marks.eye_tip: Show or hide the overlay. Hidden marks are still redacted.
ocr.busy: Text recognition is running. Wait for it to finish or cancel it.
ocr.nothing: No scanned pages without text found.
options.area_hint: Drag to cover any area · Alt+drag selects marks
options.hand_hint: Drag to scroll · hold Space in any tool for the Hand
options.snap_tip: Grow the rectangle to cover every character it touches; those characters are removed entirely anyway
options.text_hint: Drag across text to mark it · Shift+click adds to the selection
options.zoom_hint: Click to zoom in · Alt+click to zoom out
prefs.restart_body: The change will take effect the next time Redactor starts.
project.changed_body: The PDF has changed since this project was saved. Marks may no longer cover the same content, so check every one before exporting.
props.defaults_info: Applied to every mark without its own style.
props.label: Label
props.label_note: A label like [REDACTED] is printed inside the box. Basic Latin characters only.
report.checks: Checks performed on the saved file
report.fail_body: Saved to {path}, but at least one check failed. Do not share this file.
report.ok_body: Saved to {path}. The file was reopened and inspected, and the marked content is gone.
report.phrases_warn: The same words still appear unmarked elsewhere. Check whether they should be redacted too.
search.keys_hint: Enter: mark · Delete: skip · ↑↓: next hit
search.scans_note.one: {n} page is a scan without text and was not searched.
search.scans_note.other: {n} pages are scans without text and were not searched.
status.original_locked_tip: Redactor never writes to the opened PDF. Export creates a new file.
tool.ocr_missing: Text recognition data is missing in this installation
tool.ocr_tip: Recognize text on the current scanned page
undo.label: Label
verify.covered: Every marked area is fully covered on the rendered page
verify.metadata: Document metadata and XMP are empty
verify.no_text: No text objects remain in the file (flattened)
verify.phrases_absent: Marked phrases cannot be found anywhere in the file
verify.sha256_title: SHA-256 fingerprint of the exported file
verify.text_under_marks: No extractable text under {count} marked rectangles
